entities.name: Order of Heliud
entities.description: A religious organization spread across many planes that strives to bring harmony, protection and law to the Multiverse.

entities.name: Regatha
entities.description: Plane where a sect of the Order sought to bring law through hieromancy.

entities.name: Purifying Fire
entities.description: Flame that probed souls for sin and could destroy a mortal or drain a planeswalker of all power, including planeswalking.

entities.name: Gideon Jura
entities.description: Planeswalker who served the Order as an agent to study the purifying fire.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: Planeswalker pyromancer the Order sought to apprehend.

entities.name: Walbert III
entities.description: Leader of the Order's sect on Regatha, with ulterior motives against Chandra.

events.summary: The Order's Regatha sect sends those deemed criminals into the Purifying Fire.
events.quote: They sent people they deemed criminal into the Purifying Fire

events.summary: Gideon agrees to serve as an agent of the Order for a chance to study the flame.
events.quote: Gideon Jura , who agreed to serve as an agent of the Order for a chance to study the flame

events.summary: Gideon is sent to apprehend Chandra Nalaar.
events.quote: He was sent to apprehend the pyromancer Chandra Nalaar for the threat she posed to the Order's goals.

events.summary: Gideon returns with Chandra; with his help she survives Walbert's persecution and he comes to question the Order's motives.
events.quote: With Gideon's help, however, Chandra survived Walbert's persecution and gave Gideon reason to question the Order's true motives.
